sentences.text:
By means of this bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
100 of 2022 at Police Station Sumerpur, District Hamirpur under Section 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 27.04.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 04.04.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Saket Jaiswal, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted Shri Shrawan Kumar Dubey, learned AGA from the record,
entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Sharif vs State Of U.P. on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53232221/
1
1. Delay in lodgement of the F.I.R. in the facts and circumstances of this case is fatal to the prosecution case.
2. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
3. The applicant did not torture the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
4. The deceased died in a train accident.
The applicant promptly informed the parents of the deceased.
The father of the deceased/informant was a witness to the inquest report.
5. The F.I.R. was got registered 15 days after the incident only to extort money from the applicant.
6. Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.
7. The applicant is a law abiding citizen who cooperated with the police investigations and had joined the trial.
8. The applicant never influenced witnesses and tampered with the evidence.
9. The trial is moving at a snail's pace and is not likely to conclude anytime in the near future.
The applicant is not responsible for the delay in the trial.

10. Inordinate delay in concluding trial had has led to virtually an indefinite imprisonment of the applicant without there being any credible evidence to implicate him in the offence and violates the rights of the applicant to speedy trial.
11. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
12. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of her influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Sharif be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
Sharif vs State Of U.P. on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53232221/
